description: This file defines a plugin entry for the LiteLLM provider in the openclaw plugin SDK, including provider metadata, authentication config, documentation path, and catalog building. It exports a default plugin registration object using defineSingleProviderPluginEntry.

methods.name: applyLitellmConfig
methods.description: Applies the LiteLLM configuration to the provided configuration object.

methods.name: buildLitellmProvider
methods.description: Builds and returns the LiteLLM provider object based on the current configuration.
